sloka: घोराः तु पक्षिणो वाचो व्याहरन्ति समंततः ।भौमाः चैव मृगाः सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म प्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-७४-९॥
transliteration: ghorāḥ tu pakṣiṇo vāco vyāharanti samaṁtataḥ ।bhaumāḥ caiva mṛgāḥ sarve gacchanti sma pradakṣiṇam ॥1-74-9॥

translations.english: While this tiger among men Dasaratha, was returning with the hosts of sages and his sons, he observed here and there frightening birds making disagreeable sounds.
